name: Sam Cafe / Sam Coffee Roasters

location.address: 106 Fereshteh St (Shahid Fayyazi), inside Sam Center Mall, Elahiyeh, Tehran

media.alt: Sam Cafe fresh roasted coffee packaging reel
Sam Cafe / Sam Coffee Roasters Instagram profile

description: Tehran's original third-wave pioneer: single-origin beans roasted on a 12-kg Probat in-cafe, served via Chemex and siphon. Solid wifi and plugs for laptop work. Honest downsides: small, pricey, genuinely crowded, not a quiet-study spot. Open 8:00-23:00.
